item.title: By: Lynn C.
item.dc:creator: Lynn C.
item.description: As I was reading that, my eyes skimmed ahead and I thought I was going to read that asking you to smile for the camera was like asking a goat to. I think that's how it was for me. No rebelliousness in me. I just didn't see any reason to smile. <br><br>Does Kyle take after you?
item.content:encoded:
As I was reading that, my eyes skimmed ahead and I thought I was going to read that asking you to smile for the camera was like asking a goat to. I think that's how it was for me. No rebelliousness in me. I just didn't see any reason to smile.

Does Kyle take after you?

item.title: By: Carl Abbott
item.dc:creator: Carl Abbott
item.description: Hi Lynn, You said, "I never smiled as a child either. I also didn't speak very well; my own Mom couldn't understand me." Maybe that is why you can understand me so well? I didn't start speaking until after age 3, they tell me. I don't know about smiling as a child, though. It was just being asked to smile for the camera that got my goat.

item.title: By: Lynn C.
item.dc:creator: Lynn C.
item.description: I never smiled as a child either. I also didn't speak very well; my own Mom couldn't understand me. I can remember even then having a very rich inner life and I watching everything around me like it was televised.
